'''Amnon Albeck''' ({{Langx|he|אמנון אלבק}}; born August 1, 1958) is an [[Organic chemistry|organic]] and [[Bioorganic chemistry|bioorganic]] chemist.

==Biography==
Amnon Albeck<ref name="Vice-Rector">{{Cite web |title=Bar-Ilan University - BIU {{!}} Israel |url=https://www.biu.ac.il/en?id=13802&pt=1&pid=13801&level=5&cPath=35,983,13801 |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=www.biu.ac.il}}</ref> was born in [[Jerusalem]], Israel, to [[Michael Albeck|Michael]] and Shulamit Albeck on August 1, 1958. Amnon's father is the chemist Prof. [[Michael Albeck]], the fifth president of Bar Ilan University (1986-1989)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bar-Ilan University - BIU {{!}} Israel |url=https://www.biu.ac.il/en?id=6551&pt=1&pid=988&level=5&cPath=35,983,988 |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=www.biu.ac.il}}</ref> and former president of [[Israel Chemical Society|The Israel Chemical Society]] (1977-1980).<ref>{{Cite web |title=ICSThe Israel Chemical Society |url=https://www.chemistry.org.il/ |access-date=2025-05-21 |language=en-US}}</ref> His grandfather, [[Hanoch Albeck]] was a professor of [[Talmud]] at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] who was one of the founders of the scientific approach to the study of the [[Mishna]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Marcus|first=Rabbi Yosef|date=2017-07-11|title=Shiur #20: Commentaries on the Mishna from the 20th Century, Part 1|url=https://www.etzion.org.il/en/shiur-20-commentaries-mishna-20th-century-part-1|url-status=live|access-date=2021-03-02|website=www.etzion.org.il|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201128232010/https://www.etzion.org.il/en/shiur-20-commentaries-mishna-20th-century-part-1 |archive-date=2020-11-28 }}</ref>

Albeck graduated from [[Bar Ilan University]] (Ramat Gan, Israel) with a BSc in chemistry in 1982, and earned his PhD from The [[Weizmann Institute of Science]] (Rehovot, Israel), under the supervision of [[Mordechai Sheves|Mordechai (Mudi) Sheves]], in 1988. He then spent two years as a post-doctoral Fellow with [[Robert H. Abeles]] at [[Brandeis University]] in Massachusetts, USA. 

In 1990 he returned to Bar Ilan University as a faculty member at the [[Department of Chemistry, Bar Ilan University|Department of Chemistry]], where Albeck is now a Professor and the head of The [[Julius Spokojny]] Bioorganic Chemistry Laboratory.<ref>[http://ch.biu.ac.il/albeck Albeck's page at the Department of Chemistry, Bar Ilan University]</ref> He is also a member of The Marcus Center for Medicinal Chemistry at Bar Ilan University. Albeck served as The Department of Chemistry Chairman in 2008-2011, and he is Bar Ilan University's [[Rector (academia)|Vice-Rector]] since 2014.<ref name="Vice-Rector" /> In July 2020 he was elected Rector of Bar-Ilan University, due to replace Prof. [[Miriam Faust]] in office.<ref>[https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=33&pt=20&pid=4&level=1&cPath=4&type=1&news=3507 Prof. Amnon Albeck Elected Rector of Bar-Ilan University, July 5, 2020]</ref>

Amnon and his wife Shira, who is a staff scientist<ref>[http://wis-wander.weizmann.ac.il/shira-albeck-maxine-singer-prize#.VnBW2b8320V Dr. Shira Albeck, Weizmann Institute of Science] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222102824/http://wis-wander.weizmann.ac.il/shira-albeck-maxine-singer-prize#.VnBW2b8320V |date=December 22, 2015 }}</ref> at the Weizmann Institute of Science, have five children and seven grandchildren.
